hints.content: In $\text{Step }1$, he eliminates the $4$ from the original equation.  Since the $4$ in the original equation is positive, he would have to subtract it from both sides.  In this step, however, he subtracted $4$ from the left but added $4$ to the right.

question.content:
Viet solved a quadratic equation. His work is shown below.
  
**In which step did Viet make an error?**

$\begin{align}
2(x-3)^2+4&=102
\\\\
2(x-3)^2&=106&\text{Step }1
\\\\
(x-3)^2&=53&\text{Step }2
\\\\
x-3&=\pm\sqrt{53}&\text{Step }3
\\\\
x&=\pm\sqrt{53}+3&\text{Step }4
\end{align}$

[[☃ radio 1]]
